status: Fixed exploratory batch requested by the user on 2026-09-23; no intermediate scientific selection

batch.initial: One full-dev initial evaluation per mask per independent block; repeated initial evaluations are operational checks, not independent observations
batch.full: Initial and final adapter for every cell; intermediate checkpoints retain fixed v5 monitors and weights
batch.execution: Run all eight blocks; blocks 1-4 first, then 5-8. No retention gate or operator choice between blocks. Each block is an independent local queue and produces its own weight-free ZIP.
batch.replay: Unchanged v5 atomic rows and monitor membership, copied into separately plan-bound v6 manifests; one PLAN and one APPLY per composition step
batch.smoke: First mask and seed only, one update, checkpoints 0/1; never scientific evidence

analysis.primary: v4 crossed joint and ordinary task-solving endpoints retained; all v6 results are exploratory development evidence
analysis.paired_contrasts: Within each recipe: CE+CF minus CE, CE+CF+H minus CE+H; entropy contrasts and CF x H interaction use matching recipe/mask/seed/checkpoint
analysis.reporting: Report every predeclared cell, including failed retention; do not pool LR/replay recipes or select a winner and present its unadjusted interval as confirmatory
analysis.retention: Report PLAN per operation, initially strong APPLY and TRAIN/A correct-mass progress for every cell; no filtering of runs before collection
analysis.seeds: Paired continuation seeds from one shared initialization; not independent base-model training
analysis.final: Closed final remains unopened; no automatic final evaluation or confirmatory claim from this grid
analysis.provenance: Unchanged limitations of the actual base history; no new never-seen-pairs, length-extrapolation or historical-recipe claim

not_in_this_batch: Q2 without verified initialization history and its numeric gate
